name: dsh-trading-desktop
description: DSH Trading desktop app: an Electron shell that bundles a standalone Node runtime (node + npm + pnpm), the dsh host, and a preinstalled trading-web profile, so the trading GUI runs with zero preinstalled tooling.
author: DeepSeek Harness Contributors

scripts.prepare-runtime: node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && node scripts/fetch-redist.mjs && node scripts/stage-pnpm.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs
